notes.title: New update is out! Version 1.4.6
notes.content:
New update is out! Version 1.4.6

[b]What's New?[/b]
•Lucky Spin is back!!
•You can now obtain ticket item by leveling up (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80...)
•You can now earn EXP in SinglePlayer
•Rank Match will start on 03/23/2023
•New Item Dream Part "Order of Chronicles"

[*]Dreamtale Set
[*]Magic Rare System
[*]Changed Lucky Spin Awards
[*]Added option in shop to buy many quantity instead of one
[*]Added option in LuckySpin to skip animation [/list]

[b]Introducing Magic Rare System[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43463418/61309a73f4762be7f36f12f1547dde34d345dc21.png[/img]

Each time you add high item the chest and the text will change. Betting High items will grant you more winning chances!
